_about: The islands' buildables (core/build_state.gd decides, game/build_site.gd shows them). Each thing has parts lying on the islands ([x, z] from that island's middle; found for the whole party by interacting) and a bench where it is built once every part is found. The shield (data/shield.json): once built, every player takes one at the bench, and a new one whenever his broke. The boat (data/boat.json): built at the slipway, it then floats there. Game over puts every part back and takes built things away. reach = metres to a part or bench.
